the nonproductive adsorptions of cellulase onto the lignin component in lignocellulosics are a major factor in the overall hydrolysis kinetics.

we were able to develop a model to describe the hydrolysis behavior of creeping wild ryegrasses, a potential bioenergy crop, which is a good example of a difficult to hydrolyze lignocellulose biomass.
